name: MD Shahnauze Ahsan
headline: PhD Researcher in AI & Robotics
tagline: I build self-driving labs: robots, instruments, agentic AI and edge AI that run chemistry experiments in a closed loop.
heroBio: PhD researcher at ICIQ and the Universitat Rovira i Virgili, building a self-driving lab for catalysis that combines robotics, high-throughput experimentation, agentic AI and edge embedded AI. 5+ years of embedded hardware and software work across Bangladesh, France and Spain. Founder of Ahsan’s Lab and mentor to students going abroad for higher study.
bio: I am a PhD researcher in AI and robotics at the Institute of Chemical Research of Catalonia (ICIQ) and the Universitat Rovira i Virgili. My project, “AI-Driven Robotics for Catalyst Development” (Spanish national grant 2AID, RAISE subgroup), is building a self-driving lab (SDL) for catalysis: robots, real-time characterisation and machine learning working together in a closed loop. Within it I focus on agentic AI that plans and runs experiments, and on edge embedded AI that brings models onto the lab hardware itself.

I bring 5+ years of hardware and software development. I started as a hardware engineer, and over the last few years I have moved up the stack into firmware, instrument drivers, user interfaces and AI agents, so I can take a lab instrument from PCB to software. I write firmware in C/C++, Python and VHDL for STM32, ESP32, Arduino and Raspberry Pi, from bare metal and RTOS to FPGA and embedded Linux, and I design PCBs with attention to EMI/EMC, signal integrity and testability. I have delivered 8+ projects for startups, research institutes and multinational companies in Bangladesh, France and Spain. Before the PhD I was a Research Software Engineer at ICIQ, automating a high-power photoreactor, and before that I earned an Advanced Master’s in embedded systems at Grenoble INP Esisar and interned at Schneider Electric.

Earlier, in Chittagong, I founded Ahsan’s Lab, a student research group that built more than twenty-five prototypes in robotics, IoT and agri-tech. I am now expanding into machine learning and embedded AI, and I care about startups and innovation that bridge hardware and software. Alongside research, I mentor students heading to Europe through Career Abroad Mentor and built Language Coach for Bengali speakers learning French and Spanish.
